settings.server.label: Server
settings.server.description: The ntfy server's base URL, no trailing slash.
settings.topics.label: Topics
settings.topics.description: Topics to subscribe to. Nothing happens until there's at least one.
settings.keepalive_interval.label: Keepalive interval (s)
settings.keepalive_interval.description: The server's keepalive-interval. Nothing heard for twice this means the stream is dead and gets reopened.
settings.app_name.label: App name
settings.app_name.description: What the notification says it came from. Empty for the topic it arrived on.
settings.icon.label: Icon
settings.icon.description: An icon name or path for every notification. Empty for none.
settings.app_names.label: App name per topic
settings.app_names.description: Topic → app name. Topics not listed use the app name above.
settings.icons.label: Icon per topic
settings.icons.description: Topic → icon name or path. Topics not listed use the icon above.
